summary: Verified Footer & Hubungi Kami CMS editor and public landing rendering. Backend pytest 5/5 passed in test_footer_contact_cms.py: GET /api/site/content returns footer shape with default facebook/instagram/youtube; PUT /api/site/content accepts temporary extra TikTok social link + phone contact and persists via GET; javascript: URL rejected with 422 on both social_links.url and contact.items.url (not saved); mailto: contact url accepted. Original footer restored via module teardown. Frontend: Super Admin > Kelola Website > Footer & Kontak tab renders footer-contact-editor with 3 default social rows (facebook/instagram/youtube) each with editable platform/label/url + delete controls, add-footer-social button, contact section with title 'Hubungi Kami' + 4 default items (address/whatsapp x2/email) each with type/label/value/optional-url + delete, add-footer-contact, and save button. Public Landing footer renders CMS-derived social_links (all target=_blank rel=noreferrer, testids footer-facebook-link/footer-instagram-link/footer-youtube-link) and contact list (footer-contact-title + footer-contact-0..3). WhatsApp/http contact links have target=_blank rel=noreferrer; mailto opens same tab (correct). Desktop 1920 CMS + landing and mobile 390 landing have no horizontal overflow.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py still exceeds 7800 lines; footer/site-content helpers (default_footer_content, normalize_footer_*, DEFAULT_SITE_CONTENT, GET/PUT /site/content) should be extracted into a site_content module for maintainability.

FooterContactEditor.jsx: social platform select uses only 4 options (facebook/instagram/youtube/other). Consider surfacing common platforms (tiktok/x/linkedin) as first-class icons in Landing socialIcon() — currently 'other' falls back to a generic ExternalLink icon which is acceptable per requirements but reduces polish.

Landing.jsx contactHref returns mailto:/tel: for those types; the link does not set target='_blank' which is correct behavior, but note requirement 'all social links open in a new tab' was interpreted as only social — contact links use per-scheme behavior which is fine.
normalize_footer_url uses urlparse().scheme but does not lowercase scheme before comparison; 'HTTPS://...' would be rejected. Low-priority hardening.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (CMS editor + landing footer + social new-tab + no overflow)

seed_data_creation: None permanent. Ephemeral TEST_TikTok social + TEST_Hotline Tambahan / TEST_Mail contact entries appended during PUT tests and reverted by the autouse module teardown which restores the exact original footer captured at test start.
